target_pdb.description: Path to the target structure (.pdb) the binder is designed against (RFdiffusion3 Foundry binder-design mode).

candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] from an upstream tool. Promotes the first item's structure_path into `target_pdb` when omitted.

target_chain.description: Single-letter chain id on `target_pdb` to design against.

target_hotspots.description: Hotspot residue positions on the target. FASTA/sequence 1-indexed when `target_sequence`/`target_fasta_path` is provided; otherwise legacy PDB residue numbers.

target_sequence.description: Full FASTA/sequence for integer hotspot sequence-to-structure mapping.

target_fasta_path.description: FASTA file for integer hotspot sequence-to-structure mapping. Alternative to inline `target_sequence`.

position_basis.description: How to interpret integer hotspot positions: `auto` picks sequence when a target sequence is provided, else structure; `sequence` forces 1-indexed FASTA positions; `structure` forces legacy PDB residue numbering.

num_designs.description: Number of designs sampled per run.

num_diffusion_steps.description: Diffusion timesteps. Larger values improve quality at proportional cost.
